title: Pedrouços
extracted_sentences: Pedroucos is a Portuguese parish located in the municipality of Maia.
The population in 2011 was 12,149,Instituto Nacional de Estatística in an area of 2.57 km2 .
The place of Pedroucos was the most important and populous of the Aguas Santas parish.
As an autonomous religious parish it has been in existence since 1928, but the civil parish status (Freguesia) was only given to it in 1985.
